title: Youth culture of gabbers
descriptions: In this study among 1,134 adolescents, the musical preferences of ''normal'' adolescents are compared to that of gabbers, the most remarkable Dutch youth culture of the 90s.
The dataset follows the questionnaire. The missings of some variables may be interpreted als 'no'.

data_sources: The respondents were pupils of 8 comprehensive secondary schools in 4 cities (Utrecht, Apeldoorn, Den Bosch, Veghel).
